context: Tests typed prepared JDBC tools with database-enforced read-only access to the named tables, bounded results and explicit schema. agents-features-sql is checkpoint storage, not a query feature.

checklist.name: Registers read-only prepared JDBC tools
checklist.description: Registers typed @Tool / ToolSet lookups using prepared statements and an actual read-only database principal. Does not invent install(Sql), schemaScope or an automatically registered SQL query feature. Does not pass unrestricted model-generated SQL to a statement.

checklist.name: Scopes queries to the named tables
checklist.description: Fixed SQL references only public.events and public.users using verified schema names. Does not expose unrelated tables, dynamic table names or unrestricted arbitrary-query access.

checklist.name: Caps result rows
checklist.description: Applies a hard bounded result limit in executable JDBC/query code, not only a prompt instruction, and sets a query timeout. A row cap alone does not bound scan cost.

checklist.name: Reads DB credentials from environment
checklist.description: Reads ANALYTICS_DB_URL, ANALYTICS_DB_USER, ANALYTICS_DB_PASSWORD from System.getenv. Does not inline literals

checklist.name: Pins the actual schema and tool contract
checklist.description: Includes the inspected table/column names and lookup semantics in the system prompt or an approved discovery tool. Does not invent a built-in describe_schema feature.

checklist.name: Adds a JDBC driver
checklist.description: Adds the PostgreSQL JDBC driver with the existing Koog umbrella. Does not add agents-features-sql for query access; that module provides checkpoint storage.
